diagnostics.perfBaselineHint: Compare against the last recorded baseline; the threshold and the noise floor are applied in Go, jitter below the floor is not a regression
diagnostics.perfBaselineJudgeHint: Noise floor {noise}ms: jitter below it is not judged a regression; threshold and criteria live in Go
diagnostics.perfBaselineSummaryOk: vs baseline: no stage regressed beyond {threshold}%
diagnostics.perfBaselineNoiseHint: within the noise floor — not judged a regression
diagnostics.perfBaselineErrMissing: No baseline recorded yet: tick "record baseline" and run once to create one
diagnostics.perfBaselineErrSavedNote: (recorded a new baseline this run; compare from the next run)
diagnostics.perfBaselineErrUnreadable: The baseline file cannot be read (in use, no permission, or it is a directory)
diagnostics.perfBaselineErrInvalid: The baseline file is not a recognizable baseline (corrupted, or the wrong file)
diagnostics.perfBaselineErrSlotUnavailab: The standard baseline slot cannot be located (user config root unavailable): pass an explicit baseline file path
diagnostics.perfBaselineErrUnknown: Baseline unavailable (see the tooltip for the reason)
diagnostics.perfConcurrentHint: Measured serial-vs-parallel speedup (tiers 2 / 4 / target); speedup and verdict are decided in Go
diagnostics.perfConcurrentJudgeHint: The speedup verdict is decided in Go; the UI only renders it and never recomputes thresholds
diagnostics.perfConcurrentParamInvalid: Invalid concurrent parameters: workers must be 1~256, the sample cap must be >= 1, and the target set cannot be the single-model option (concurrent runs have no model path input)
diagnostics.perfConcurrentEmpty: No concurrent bench result (the repo may have no CLI-analyzable model)
diagnostics.perfScanBenchHint: Scan the same repo root with both Go and Rust and report median/p95; an engine that was not measured shows the reason, not 0ms
diagnostics.perfScanBenchSkipped: {n} more runs were not counted as samples (cache hit / ownership undecidable)
diagnostics.perfScanBenchReasonUnavailab: rust_backend is not enabled in this build
diagnostics.perfScanBenchReasonFellBack: The Rust backend did not handle this run (unavailable at runtime, fell back to Go)
diagnostics.perfScanBenchReasonCacheHit: Scan cache hit, no engine ran
diagnostics.perfScanBenchParityMatch: Entry set and key fields match one by one
diagnostics.perfScanBenchParityNotCompar: Cannot compare (both engines were not measured)
diagnostics.perfScanBenchEmpty: No engine comparison result (the repo may have no CLI-analyzable model)
diagnostics.perfTargetAllHint: N per type: scans **every** type in the registry (including types the CLI cannot analyze; those yield identity only, with no stage timings collected)
diagnostics.perfTargetRepo: Top N of the whole repo (ungrouped)
diagnostics.perfTargetRepoHint: Top N of the whole repo: no grouping by type — take the top N of the whole repo by the chosen order; JSON payload only
diagnostics.perfMaxModelsHint: What this number means depends on the scope you pick in "What to test": a type = take N of that type; N per type = take N of EVERY type (the total can far exceed N when there are many types); top N of the whole repo = take N from the whole repo
diagnostics.perfMatrixUnsupported: No CLI parser for this type — stage timings not collected
diagnostics.perfReasonNoCliParser: Parser lives in the front-end 3D adapter only; CLI cannot analyze this type
diagnostics.perfCliTimingHint: Time spent inside the CLI command itself (excludes parsing and rendering on this page)
diagnostics.perfMatrixStageMismatch: Stage chain differs from the manifest
diagnostics.perfMatrixEmpty: No model of this type found in the repo
diagnostics.perfSizeSourceDirTotal: directory models summed over directory content, others by file size
diagnostics.perfSizeSourceUnknown: this size basis is not registered in the UI
diagnostics.perfModelFootprintHint: Footprint used for ranking (directory models summed over directory content, others by file size)
diagnostics.perfTrendNoData: No trend yet — run single-bench twice or more to show the chart
diagnostics.perfIdle: Click the button above to start; results will appear here
diagnostics.perfModeHint: How to run = which benchmark command; “What to test” alongside = how wide this run goes. They are independent: pick the command, then the scope
diagnostics.loadTraceHint: Records automatically after loading a model; click refresh to view
diagnostics.loadTraceCoarseHint: this format records one combined stage only (adapter timer granularity differs)

about.intro: is a model management tool for the Minecraft YSM mod, letting you manage your model collection like a Steam Workshop.
about.f2: Smart sorting by author, character, and work

about.f5: Hard-link install, no redundant file copies
about.f6: Modpack sync, recycle bin, batch operations
about.f7: Android viewer mode · Web version (in development)
